fact: The Namibia Revenue Agency's Integrated Tax Administration System e-portal (ITAS) states that once logged in, taxpayers can submit their returns online.
NamRA says taxpayers file returns through its ITAS portal, which has faults but is partly restored, and it extended the filing deadline from 30 June to 31 August 2026.

NamRA said its approved digital transformation strategy, with some programmes already underway and World Bank support for a digital tax ecosystem, aims to integrate the Integrated Tax Administration System and let taxpayers file online.
